column1: # The comparable populations found in this set of papers.

column2: Single-span standing seam roof base tests under gravity loading
column3: Single-span, simply supported, two-purlin-line standing seam roof assemblies loaded to failure by vacuum chamber (gravity), i.e. AISI base tests, all reporting a failure load per purlin line and, mostly, a base-test reduction factor R.

column2: Tensile coupon tests of purlin and panel steel
column3: Standard ASTM tensile coupons cut from purlin (and in some reports sheet/panel) material of the test specimens, all reporting coupon dimensions, yield stress, ultimate strength and elongation.

column2: Measured purlin cross-section geometry, per purlin line
column3: Per-purlin measured cross-section dimensions (depth, thickness, flange widths, lip lengths, bend radii and lip angles) recorded with the same measurement scheme and figure nomenclature in three Murray-era reports.

column2: AISI computed section properties and predicted capacities, per test purlin
column3: AISI effective-section analyses computed from the measured dimensions of each test purlin, giving gross and effective section properties, element-governed allowable moments, the predicted uniform failure load and the computed deflection per 100 plf.

column2: Single-span through-fastened purlin roof assemblies under gravity loading
column3: Single-span, simply supported C- and Z-purlin roof assemblies with conventional through-fastened panels, loaded to failure downward (concrete blocks or vacuum chamber), each reporting a failure load per purlin and an AISI constrained-bending prediction.

column2: Multi-span continuous lapped purlin roof assemblies under gravity loading
column3: Full-scale multi-span continuous purlin roof assemblies with lapped purlins over the interior supports, loaded downward to failure (vacuum chamber or simulated gravity), reporting a failure load per purlin line for the continuous system.
